backend: PyTorch XPU on Intel Arc Pro B70; no CPU/CUDA inference fallback
scope: Three previously refusing development prompts from distinct available families and one benign bicycle control; deliberately targeted, not an unbiased benchmark or holdout.
finding: All four winners selected no edit at both checkpoints. Edited branches changed downstream norms/readout metrics but had worse proxy objectives; no branch was rejected by the configured protection guards. Baseline and finalist final-answer text was identical in every case. No refusal reduction was observed.
ranking: Uncalibrated J-space token-margin proxy; the learned behavior ranker remains untrained and was not used.
verification: Read sealed task traces and all eight AnswerStore records back, checked trace lengths against expansion counts, and aggregated the saved responses programmatically.
